name: print-social-frosted-glass-event-card-over-olive-teal-gradient-carousel-slide
title: Frosted Event Card over Olive-Teal Gradient
whatItIs: An Instagram carousel slide on a blurred teal-to-olive gradient with a light serif line 'Dance on the sand until sunset', above a large frosted glass card holding a sunny beach-club photo, the event name in white, a date and time and a small sparkle icon.
whatItMeans: A translucent card floating on a colour wash reads like a mini app card, and the sunny photo pops against the moody gradient.
techniques: Frosted card holding a photo and details
Blurred gradient sampled from the photo
Light serif headline above the card
Date and time in two weights
Sparkle icon as a brand mark

vocabulary.definition: A translucent blurred card over a coloured backdrop.
Taking a background gradient from an image's colours.
A card summarising an event with photo, title and time.
